label: Folder
depicts: Folder outline with a short top tab and a flat lower body panel
use_when: Use when the interface wants the simplest closed folder shape with one top tab.
avoid_when: Do not use for striped or corner fold folders when the body should stay plain.

label: Folder
depicts: Folder outline with a top band stripe running across the upper body
use_when: Use when the interface wants a closed folder with a visible horizontal band across the body.
avoid_when: Do not use for the plain folder when the upper stripe should remain visible.

label: Folder
depicts: Rounded folder outline with a folded top right corner panel
use_when: Use when the interface wants a folder whose main cue is the folded panel at the top right.
avoid_when: Do not use for plain tab folders when the folded corner panel is visible.

label: Open Folder
depicts: Open folder outline with a front panel tilted downward from the tab edge
use_when: Use when the interface wants a folder shown opened toward the viewer with a tilted front panel.
avoid_when: Do not use for the flatter open folder when the front panel tilt is the visible difference.

label: Open Folder
depicts: Open folder outline with a broad open mouth and a flatter front panel
use_when: Use when the interface wants an open folder with a wider flatter front opening.
avoid_when: Do not use for the more tilted open folder when the broad open mouth is the main cue.
